caption: A bus drives behind a tall building and emerges from the other side a moment later.

sa.check: A bus drives along a street.
It passes behind a tall building.
It emerges from the other side.
The disappearance comes first and the emergence follows.

pc.expect: It is the same bus, and it does not show through the building.
pc.fail: A different bus emerges; or two buses; or the bus appears elsewhere.

pc.expect: It is hidden for a time matching its speed and the building's width and reappears at the same speed and heading.
pc.fail: It emerges instantly; or after far too long; or emerges going back.

pc.expect: The bus is not visible through the building.
pc.fail: It shows through; or passes through the building; or the building passes through the bus.
It moves; or vanishes; or the street changes.

pc.expect: One bus and one building keep their shape.
pc.fail: The bus turns into another vehicle; or the building changes shape; or the bus merges with it.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The bus's colours and the street stay the same.
pc.fail: The bus changes colour; or the building changes; or the street rearranges.
